prompt: TokenBucket in ratelimit/bucket.py has two refill bugs: it under-refills when polled often (fractional tokens are lost, so rate=0.5 checked every second never refills), and it over-refills after idle periods (tokens grow past capacity, allowing bursts larger than capacity). Fix both. Then add wait_time(cost=1) to TokenBucket: the seconds until allow(cost) would succeed (0.0 if it would succeed now), without consuming tokens. A cost greater than capacity can never succeed: allow() and wait_time() must raise ValueError for it. KeyedLimiter (ratelimit/limiter.py) must keep working with independent buckets per key.
